arxiv-2006-08098.title: Utility and Privacy in Object Tracking from Video Stream using Kalman Filter
arxiv-2006-08098.creator: Niladri Das & Raktim Bhattacharya
arxiv-2006-08098.description: Abstract Tracking objects in Computer Vision is a hard problem. Privacy and utility concerns adds an extra layer of complexity over this problem. In this work we consider the problem of maintaining privacy and utility while tracking an object in a video stream using Kalman filtering.

arxiv-2105-01792.title: Aggregate Cyber-Risk Management in the IoT Age: Cautionary Statistics for (Re)Insurers and Likes
arxiv-2105-01792.creator: RANJAN PAL, ZIYUAN HUANG, XINLONG YIN, SERGEY LOTOTSKY
arxiv-2105-01792.description: Abstract IoT-driven smart societies are modern service-networked ecosystems, whose proper functioning is hugely based on the success of supply chain relationships. Robust security is still a big challenge in such ecosystems, catalyzed primarily by naive cyber-security practices (e.g., setting default IoT device passwords) on behalf of the ecosystem managers, i.e., users and organizations.

arxiv-2202-03466.title: Reward-Respecting Subtasks for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning Journal: Artificial Intelligence
arxiv-2202-03466.creator: Richard S. Sutton, Marlos C. Machado, G. Zacharias Holland, David Szepesvari, Finbarr Timbers, Brian Tanner, Adam White
arxiv-2202-03466.description: Abstract To achieve the ambitious goals of artificial intelligence, reinforcement learning must include planning with a model of the world that is abstract in state and time. Deep learning has made progress with state abstraction, but temporal abstraction has rarely been used, despite extensively developed theory based on the options framework.

arxiv-2209-05838.title: SATViz : Real-Time Visualization of Clausal Proofs
arxiv-2209-05838.creator: Tim Holzenkamp, Kevin Kuryshev, Thomas Oltmann, Lucas Wäldele, Johann Zuber, Tobias Heuer, Markus Iser
arxiv-2209-05838.description: Abstract Visual layouts of graphs representing SAT instances can highlight the community structure of SAT instances. The community structure of SAT instances has been associated with both instance hardness and known clause quality heuristics. Our tool SATViz visualizes CNF formulas using the variable interaction graph and a force-directed layout algorithm.

arxiv-2210-09793.title: High-velocity tails of the inelastic and the multi-species mixture Boltzmann equations
arxiv-2210-09793.creator: Gayoung An and Donghyun Lee
arxiv-2210-09793.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Gayoung An and Donghyun Lee. We study high-velocity tails of some homogeneous Boltzmann equations on v ∈ ℝ v d v\in\mathbb{R}_{v}^{d} . First, we consider spatially homogeneous Inelastic Boltzmann equation with noncutoff collision kernel, in the case of moderately soft potentials. We also study spatially homogeneous mixture Boltzmann equations : for both noncutoff collision kernel with moderately soft potentials and cutoff collision kernel with hard potentials.

arxiv-2212-02444.title: Homotopy type theory as internal languages of diagrams of ∞ \infty -logoses
arxiv-2212-02444.creator: Taichi Uemura
arxiv-2212-02444.description: Abstract We show that certain diagrams of ∞ \infty -logoses are reconstructed in internal languages of their oplax limits via lex, accessible modalities, which enables us to use plain homotopy type theory to reason about not only a single ∞ \infty -logos but also a diagram of ∞ \infty -logoses.

arxiv-2305-19629.creator: Sergi Nadal, Raquel Panadero, Javier Flores, Oscar Romero
arxiv-2305-19629.description: Abstract . We study the problem of discovering joinable datasets at scale. We approach the problem from a learning perspective relying on profiles. These are succinct representations that capture the underlying characteristics of the schemata and data values of datasets, which can be efficiently extracted in a distributed and parallel fashion.

arxiv-2309-14411.title: Signatures of Parafermion Zero Modes in Fractional Quantum Hall-Superconductor Heterostructures
arxiv-2309-14411.creator: Junyi Cao, Angela Kou, Eduardo Fradkin
arxiv-2309-14411.description: Abstract Parafermion zero modes can arise in hybrid structures composed of ν = 1 / m \nu=1/m fractional quantum Hall edges proximity coupled by an s-wave superconductor. Here we consider a Josephson junction formed in such hybrid structures in addition to parafermion tunneling, Cooper pair tunneling, and backscattering.

arxiv-2409-13196.title: BoilerTAI: A Platform for Enhancing Instruction Using Generative AI in Educational Forums
arxiv-2409-13196.creator: Anvit Sinha 1 , Shruti Goyal 1 , Zachary Sy 1 , Rhianna Kuperus 2 , Ethan Dickey 1 and Andres Bejarano 1
arxiv-2409-13196.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Anvit Sinha 1 , Shruti Goyal 1 , Zachary Sy 1 , Rhianna Kuperus 2 , Ethan Dickey 1 and Andres Bejarano 1. Contribution : This Full paper in the Research Category track describes a practical, scalable platform that seamlessly integrates Generative AI (GenAI) with online educational forums, offering a novel approach to augment the instructional capabilities of staff. The platform empowers instructional staff to efficiently manage, refine, and approve responses by facilitating interaction between student posts and a Large Language Model (LLM).

arxiv-2409-16630.title: Stochastic Subsampling With Average Pooling
arxiv-2409-16630.creator: Bum Jun Kim, Sang Woo Kim
arxiv-2409-16630.description: Abstract Regularization of deep neural networks has been an important issue to achieve higher generalization performance without overfitting problems. Although the popular method of Dropout provides a regularization effect, it causes inconsistent properties in the output, which may degrade the performance of deep neural networks.

arxiv-2505-13089.title: Systematic Generalization in Language Models Scales with Information Entropy
arxiv-2505-13089.creator: Sondre Wold, Lucas Georges Gabriel Charpentier, Étienne Simon
arxiv-2505-13089.description: Abstract Systematic generalization remains challenging for current language models, which are known to be both sensitive to semantically similar permutations of the input and to struggle with known concepts presented in novel contexts. Although benchmarks exist for assessing compositional behavior, it is unclear how to measure the difficulty of a systematic generalization problem.

pmc-10632459.title: Rational design of microRNA-responsive switch for programmable translational control in mammalian cells
pmc-10632459.creator: Hui Ning, Gan Liu, Lei Li, Qiang Liu, Huiya Huang, Zhen Xie
pmc-10632459.description: Artificial RNA translation modulation usually relies on multiple components, such as RNA binding proteins (RBPs) or microRNAs (miRNAs) for off-switches and double-inverter cascades for on-switches. Recently, translational circular RNAs (circRNAs) were developed as promising alternatives for linear messenger RNAs (mRNAs). However, circRNAs still lack straightforward and programmable translation control strategies.

pmc-10647042.title: The landscape of drug resistance in Plasmodium falciparum malaria in the Democratic Republic of Congo: a mapping systematic review
pmc-10647042.creator: Nadine Kalenda Kayiba, Evariste Tshibangu-Kabamba, Angel Rosas-Aguirre, Natsuko Kaku, Yu Nakagama, Akira Kaneko, Dieudonné Mvumbi Makaba, Doudou Yobi Malekita, Brecht Devleesschauwer, Joris Losimba Likwela, Pius Kabututu Zakayi, Patrick DeMol, Georges Mvumbi Lelo, Marie-Pierre Hayette, Paul Lusamba
pmc-10647042.description: ContextThe Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), one of the most malaria-affected countries worldwide, is a potential hub for global drug-resistant malaria. This study aimed at summarizing and mapping surveys of malaria parasites carrying molecular markers of drug-resistance across the country.

pmc-11271873.title: Polyamines (PAs) but not small peptides with closely spaced positively charged groups interact with DNA and RNA, but they do not represent a relevant buffer system at physiological pH values
pmc-11271873.creator: Julian Rieck, Christian Derst, Rüdiger W. Veh
pmc-11271873.description: Polyamines (PAs) including putrescine (PUT), spermidine (SPD) and spermine (SPM) are small, versatile molecules with two or more positively charged amino groups. Despite their importance for almost all forms of life, their specific roles in molecular and cellular biology remain partly unknown.

pmc-11547716.creator: Chihiro Ushiroda, Kanako Deguchi, Risako Yamamoto-Wada, Hiroko Tanaka, Chisato Ono, Mitsuyoshi Yoshida, Masayoshi Sarai, Ryoji Miyahara, Hitomi Sasaki, Katsumi Iizuka, Roberto Iacone

pmc-12437948.title: Late Onset Schizophrenia: What Can We Learn? A Qualitative Study of Psychopathology and Social Factors Throughout Life
pmc-12437948.creator: A Urfer Parnas, C Krogh, J Nordgaard, M Gram Henriksen, J E Yttri
pmc-12437948.description: IntroductionIn 1943, Manfred Bleuler noted that late-onset schizophrenia (LOS) is an overlooked patient group, but accounts for 20% of all patients diagnosed with schizophrenia. There is a limited interest in this subgroup perhaps because of the focus on patients with early onset of schizophrenia currently.

pmc-13121101.title: Perioperative clinical profiles and longitudinal outcomes in patients supported by continuous-flow left ventricular assist devices: a comprehensive analysis of early and late follow-up data
pmc-13121101.creator: Qiuju Ding, Qingqing Zhu, Zeyi Zhou, Cheng Chen, Zhenjun Xu, Jun Pan, Min Ge
pmc-13121101.description: IntroductionMechanical circulatory support technology, particularly continuous-flow left ventricular assist devices (CF-LVADs), has emerged as a vital therapeutic option for end-stage heart failure (ESHF). However, domestic data on the long-term efficacy and safety of CF-LVADs in real-world settings remain limited, necessitating further investigation to guide clinical practice.

pmc-13282877.creator: Lisha Kuang, Pantao Shu

pmc-13395395.title: Temporal Trends in the Incidence and Prevalence of Multiple Sclerosis in Sweden, 2001–2021
pmc-13395395.creator: Astrid Pedersen, Fredrik Sandesjö, Peter Alping, Thomas Frisell, Fredrik Piehl, Katharina Fink, Kyla A. Mckay
pmc-13395395.description: IntroductionUnderstanding secular trends in demographic patterns of multiple sclerosis (MS) may help elucidate its etiopathogenesis and is also important for future resource allocation and planning healthcare strategies. Though several incidence and prevalence studies exist, nationwide studies utilizing contemporary data collected over decades remain rare.

pmc-13402343.title: Uniform nanoporous zirconia composite membrane enabling high-performance alkaline water electrolysis
pmc-13402343.creator: Zhipeng Xu, Zhihao Lin, Daohui He, Jingjing Yin, Yangke Pan, Liang Guo, Junbin Liao, Huimin Ruan, Congjie Gao, Jiangnan Shen, Young Moo Lee
pmc-13402343.description: Zirconia-based membranes typically face a trade-off between ionic transport and gas barrier performance, limiting their effectiveness in alkaline water electrolysis, where low area resistance, high bubble-point pressure, and long-term stability are essential. Here we show a method for fabricating a nanoporous composite membrane. Yttria-stabilized zirconia nanoparticles are uniformly dispersed into a sol-state polybenzimidazole matrix via a one-pot sol-gel process.

pmc-13445593.title: Anticancer effects of tangeretin associated with reactive oxygen species generation, mitochondrial dysfunction and apoptosis in CaSki cells
pmc-13445593.creator: Seung-Hyeon Ahn, Zeeshan Ahmad Bhutta, Hwayoung Na, Hong Kyu Lee, Kyung-Chul Choi
pmc-13445593.description: Cervical cancer is the fourth most common cancer and the fourth leading cause of cancer-related mortality among women worldwide. Tangeretin (TAN), a polymethoxylated flavonoid derived from citrus fruit peel, exhibits relatively high structural stability due to its methoxy groups and exerts anticancer effects in various malignancies, including lung, liver and breast cancer.
